execution.implementation: deterministic analysis of the public GSE52778 Dex-versus-untreated processed Cuffdiff table plus a separate Rosalind launcher observation; no Rosalind scientific job executed

observations: The retained public comparison has 23,273 rows, of which 13,513 status-OK gene rows were tested.
At q <= 0.05, 316 rows are significant after direction is recomputed as log2(Dex FPKM / untreated FPKM).
The leading retained genes include SPARCL1, KLF15, FKBP5, SAMHD1, GPX3, C7, SERPINA3, MAOA, DUSP1, and CCDC69.
interpretation: The authors' processed table shows a strong dexamethasone-associated response in airway smooth-muscle cells.
The predeclared theme panels are descriptive organization aids and do not constitute formal pathway enrichment.
limitations: This is an analysis of the authors' processed Cuffdiff result, not a raw-read or count-level reanalysis.
The study has four donors, and donor pairing and other design terms are not re-estimated here.
The Rosalind call verified launcher readiness only and executed no scientific job.

provenance.note: The builder computes the scientific summaries from the retained public GEO file. outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json records the genuine mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open call separately and states that no scientific job executed.

reproduction: Run python build_case.py to retrieve the public processed comparison and regenerate outputs.
Confirm 23,273 source rows, 13,513 status-OK rows, and 316 rows at q <= 0.05.
Inspect outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json separately as launcher-readiness evidence.
